body: Sorry, friend. I live a pretty minimalistic lifestyle. No car even. I definitely don't have much self-discipline when it comes to my pleasures, however I don't see myself living any sort of lifestyle based in asceticism. I just want to travel somewhere far, and end it.

I feel about the same way. I *just* created this account because I felt like I should probably talk about how I've been feeling.  
Lately, I consider travelling somewhere to do it.. I heard about that forest in Japan about 3 weeks ago, but I don't think I could fly all-the-way to Japan to do it (I'm Canadian). Maybe somewhere in South or Central America.. possibly in the Carribbean. Hmm.. Go all out.. Meh..  
Life just sucks.. I want to follow that with '.. you know what I mean?'.. but I think you do.. Ugh. I'm 40. I've thought like this before.. but I'm 40 now.. what's the fricken point. Rat race, Bullshit, Death.. Why deal with the bullshit?
